character: One of Austria's largest linked ski areas, the Skicircus joins Saalbach and Hinterglemm with Leogang in Salzburg and, across the border in Tyrol, Fieberbrunn on one ticket. Most of the 270 km are blue and red runs between about 840 m and 2,096 m, and Saalbach hosted the 2025 FIS Alpine World Ski Championships, with three new gondolas built beforehand.
learning: Search summary: over half of the piste km are blue. Reference note: every village has ski schools and nursery areas; confirm lesson products.
